watches.name: Doppio Ponte
watches.description: The Doppio Ponte sunglasses by Pilo & Co Genève embody the perfect blend of modern sophistication and timeless craftsmanship. Their transparent brown acetate frame reveals a subtle warmth, while polarized lenses offer exceptional clarity and protection from glare. Designed in Switzerland, these sunglasses express effortless elegance, ideal for those who value precision, comfort, and style in every detail.

watches.name: Pantera
watches.description: The Pantera Camo sunglasses from Pilo & Co Genève capture the daring spirit of contemporary Swiss design. With a striking brown and black camouflage frame, these polarized lenses offer crystal-clear vision and superior glare protection. Designed for those who embrace individuality, Pantera blends luxury craftsmanship with urban attitude — a statement accessory that pairs technical excellence with effortless style.

watches.name: Ozzy Brown Camo
watches.description: The Ozzy Brown Camo sunglasses by Pilo & Co Genève embody confidence, individuality, and modern design. Featuring a distinctive brown camouflage frame and precision-engineered polarized lenses, they combine rugged aesthetics with refined craftsmanship. Built for comfort and everyday versatility, the Ozzy Brown Camo is the perfect accessory for those who value both performance and personality. Key Features: Polarized lenses for superior visual clarity and glare reduction Unique brown camouflage acetate frame Lightweight, durable build for long-lasting comfort Swiss-designed with exceptional attention to detail Ideal for casual and urban lifestyles

watches.name: Ozzy Black Transparent
watches.description: The Ozzy Black Transparent sunglasses by Pilo & Co Genève redefine contemporary eyewear with Swiss precision and bold minimalism. Featuring a semi-transparent black acetate frame and polarized lenses, they deliver both striking aesthetics and high-performance vision. Lightweight, durable, and effortlessly stylish — these sunglasses are crafted for those who appreciate timeless design with a modern edge. Key Features: Polarized lenses for glare-free clarity and eye comfort Transparent black acetate frame with sleek contours Precision Swiss craftsmanship and detailing Lightweight construction for day-long wear A perfect balance of luxury and urban style

watches.name: Ozzy Black
watches.description: The Ozzy Black sunglasses from Pilo & Co Genève combine minimalist sophistication with refined optical performance. Featuring a striking matte black frame and polarized lenses, these sunglasses reduce glare and enhance clarity—perfect for both urban and outdoor settings. Their design reflects Pilo & Co’s Swiss craftsmanship, blending clean lines and comfort to deliver an eyewear staple that’s both functional and stylish. Key Features: Polarized lenses for glare reduction and improved visual clarity Matte black frame with modern, understated elegance Lightweight, durable construction ideal for daily wear Swiss-inspired design and attention to detail

watches.name: Aviatori Arancioni
watches.description: The Aviatori Arancioni sunglasses by Pilo & Co Genève embody fearless style and Swiss precision. With their vivid orange aviator frame and polarized lenses, these sunglasses offer exceptional clarity, glare reduction, and all-day comfort. Designed for those who dare to stand out, Aviatori Arancioni blends timeless aviator heritage with contemporary flair — a perfect reflection of modern elegance. Key Features: Polarized lenses for superior clarity and glare protection Iconic aviator shape in a striking orange finish Lightweight, durable construction for long wear Swiss design and craftsmanship for premium quality Two-year warranty on parts and labor (excluding misuse and leather parts)
